text:
rachel: quick heads-up — saw a host-side latency regression in east canary after the allocator trim change. p95 up ~14% on decode-heavy tiny-streams. trace points to alloc/free churn + small-write syscalls. :thinking:

rachel: flame summary:
```
host-parse: +12% CPU
allocator: freelist misses +4x
syscall/writev: small-write calls +7% (many 32-64B writes)
kernel-selection: flipped to slower kernel on ~20% of tiny batches
```

diego: which allocator change exactly? we merged `pool/trim-on-idle` yesterday to reduce RSS.
rachel: that one. under burst it returns buffers to OS too eagerly causing malloc churn and page faults (madvise). also we moved small-size freelists to a shared pool with a thin lock — increased contention for short lived requests.
anika: quick mitigations:
- re-enable per-thread caches for size classes <= 4KB
- add fast-path borrow (no-copy) for in-order frame headers
- add `framer` writev coalescer to reduce syscall count

anika: and add allocator metrics: `pool_miss_count`, `freelist_wait_us`, `madvise_trim_count` so we can correlate.
diego: +1. also set trim threshold to idle > 1s (instead of immediate) to avoid thrash during spikes. we can still reclaim in low-traffic windows.
perf-bot: canary build for branches: `perf/framer-pool-fix` + `framer/coalesce` started — job id 9001, traffic 4% east-canary.
rachel: quick canary results after ~30min: p95 down ~9% vs broken canary but p99 still ~15% above prod baseline. `pool_miss_count` dropped by ~60% though, so allocator churn reduced. small_write_syscalls dropped median 3 -> 1.
diego: sounds promising. remaining delta probably due to kernel selector flipping combined with rare kvcache evictions. we should: 1) add sticky-kernel per-request (don't switch mid-request), 2) smooth selector with EWMA, 3) emit `selector_flip_rate`.
anika: I'll push a tiny patch for sticky-kernel + `selector.debug_sample=0.5%` to capture full decision context for a tiny fraction of requests. also will add `small_write_count` per-request metric.
ops-bot: debug sampling enabled (0.5%). monitoring hooks: allocator_metrics, selector_metrics, small_write_count, kvcache_evictions.
diego: after sticky-kernel + pooling + coalesce in the canary, p99 improved to within ~3% of baseline on 4% traffic. promoting to 25% for 12h observation.
rachel: note for follow-ups: don't use `madvise(DONTNEED)` on short-lived buffers — it caused costly page faults. use delayed trim (idle > 1s) and prefer returning to OS in maintenance windows. TASKS: TASK-1300 (allocator telemetry), TASK-1301 (framer pooling+coalesce), TASK-1302 (selector smoothing).
perf-bot: canary promoted to 25% (job 9001). will report after 12h window.
rachel: thanks team — nice triage. we'll merge after 12h steady run. :thumbsup:
